title: Retrospective evaluation of characteristics of improved pediatric surgery care of preterm and newborn infants and pediatric cases up to 18 years of age
summary: This study analyzes existing clinical routine data from preterm infants, newborns and children up to 18 years of age who underwent pediatric surgery. The aim is to evaluate quality of care and factors influencing outcomes. No additional procedures or burdens arise for patients.
conditions: Pediatric surgical conditions requiring operative treatment in preterm infants, newborns and children up to 18 years of age

interventions.name: Retrospective observation of preterm infants, neonates, children and adolescents up to 18 years of age undergoing pediatric surgery. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients below 18 years of age who underwent pediatric surgical procedures at the University Medical Center Ulm or associated centers between 2005 and 2025
Exclusion criteria:
Patients with insufficient or missing routine clinical data
